questions.stem: A 65-year-old male presents with chest pain radiating to his left arm and jaw. He has a past medical history of hypertension and dyslipidemia. On physical examination, his blood pressure is 150/90 mmHg. An electrocardiogram (ECG) reveals ST-segment depression in leads V2-V6.Troponin levels are elevated. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
